presets.name: Slow pan
presets.description: A gentle sine drifting side to side over two bars.

presets.name: Eighth pan
presets.description: A bounce from side to side on every eighth.

presets.name: Hard pan steps
presets.description: A square wave jumping from side to side on the eighths.

presets.name: Random pan
presets.description: Sixteenths landing anywhere across the stereo field.

presets.name: Drifting pan
presets.description: Slow, wandering movement for pads, not tied to the tempo.

presets.name: Bass-safe pan
presets.description: A quarter-note pan with the lows held in the middle.

presets.name: Classic tremolo
presets.description: The steady throb of an amp's tremolo.

presets.name: Vintage tremolo
presets.description: An optical tremolo's softer, warmer pulse, for electric pianos.

presets.name: Harmonic tremolo
presets.description: The lows and highs pulsing in turn, as on old amps.

presets.name: Stereo tremolo
presets.description: The sides pulsing in turn on the eighths.

presets.name: Spinning tremolo
presets.description: The sides pulsing at different speeds, drifting in and out of step.

presets.name: Choppy gate
presets.description: Hard sixteenth-note chops, for pads and synths.

presets.name: Beat pump
presets.description: The level dips on each beat and swells back, like a sidechain.

presets.name: Swell after the hit
presets.description: Notes start clean and the tremolo fades in behind them.
